name: Sze Yuen Pua
headline: Head of Marketing | Designing, Optimizing, Managing & Leading Strategic Marketing for Innovative Digital, Software & AI Solutions | SXO , AIO & AEO

sections.bio:
12+ years of international experience in SaaS & technology, with a well-rounded background spanning software consulting, sales, AI product marketing & management, and integrated GTM strategies. I've led customer-centric marketing initiatives, launched digital & SaaS products, AI-powered solutions, new features and strategic integrations, driving product & digital innovation, revenue growth and marketing transformation through software , data & AI in APAC, EU & US.

Currently heading marketing @ Venuerific.

What I've worked on:
- callstats.io's Optimize, AI for WebRTC analytics
- callstats.io's integration with Microsoft's Universal Windows Platform, Amazon Connect & various SDKs
- ADA's WhatsApp Business Platform, AI/NLP engine & AI-powered WhatsApp chatbots
- respond.io's Meta Product Catalog , AI Agent & a few AI features on mobile

posts.text:
The businesses that are innovating aren't just adopting AI - they're combining both artificial & human intelligence to help their customers in ways that weren't possible before.

On 15 & 16 July, the conversations will be at Penang's Setia SPICE Convention Center — where Malaysia's AI and digital transformation future is being shaped at PDX2026 | Penang Digitalisation-AI Conference & Exhibition. 

From Meta's AI agent for WhatsApp Business launch to Agentic AI discovery — we're no longer asking if AI will transform how we work. It already has.

#AI #DigitalTransformation #PDX2026 #Innovation #AEO

Last Saturday's DIGITALCONFEX's 7th Digital Marketing, Advertising & Technology Conference was filled with AI-packed conversations and valuable insights throughout the day at Hyatt Place Kuala Lumpur, Bukit Jalil. 🇲🇾

🧠 Key takeaways from the panel discussions covered omnichannel strategy, organic & AI-driven discovery, data-led creativity, customer experience and LLM optimization—all of which are helping brands and organizations to rethink & evolve modern customer journeys in unified , differentiated & adaptive ways to drive growth with AI , including AI Agents.

Beyond the insights, was inspiring to connect with panelists & attendees in conversations around innovation, learning and transformation in the AI-yet- human era of marketing.  Thank you to everyone I met! 🤝

🧑‍💻 Truly honored for the recognition and the opportunity to join this conference, celebrating the spirit of innovation and the future of marketing. Big thanks again to Meetali Batra Joshi, Ayush Pathak & the DIGITALCONFEX team for the invitation and award - really enjoyed the conference.  

#DMATMalaysia #MarketingStrategy #DMATConfex  #AI #DigitalTransformation #MarketingInsights #CustomerExperience #DIGITALCONFEX

What an incredible two days at Fusecon 2025! 🙌  

It was a vibrant & progressive event that showcased the evolution & transformation of product & design 🎉.

The conference was filled with conversations, stories and insights at the forefront of adaptive innovation across the design, product, and tech community Mixpanel Roche Grab PETRONAS — 🌊 a renewed outlook in which AI is more than just a tool; it’s a catalyst for transforming mindsets & culture, reimagining leadership, and advancing design thinking to shape inclusive, universal design to drive impactful outcomes for customers and humankind.

Key takeaways💡:

1️⃣ Innovation continues to be a mindset
2️⃣ Design clarity & thinking are essential to navigate complex problems
3️⃣ Putting customer value at the heart of innovation
4️⃣ Embracing change and adaptability to create lasting impact

A big thank you to Johnny Woo and Design Leadership MY for putting together such an amazing conference —and for having Venuerific be part of designing the future & shaping what’s next in innovation at PJPAC. 

Till the next one! ✨💜

#fusecon2025 #DesignProductTech #continuousinnovation #turndataintodecisions

Thrilled that Venuerific is a community partner of FUSECON 2025, an amazing design conference organized by Design Leadership MY ! ✨

Over the years, it has been inspiring to have had the opportunity to collaborate closely with some of the most talented & forward-thinking product and UI/UX teams to develop, build and launch innovative AI solutions 🌏 globally. I'm looking forward to this conference at PJPAC this year with the region's brightest design, product & tech minds — get your tickets today! 💡Well-designed software products & apps don’t just transform UI/UX— they unlock new possibilities and drive growth. 💥

#uiux #saas #design

AI is shaping the future, but it’s at events - such as conferences and summits - where conversations drive innovation & discovery across industries.

From SuperAI in June to the ASEAN AI Malaysia Summit 2025 at the Malaysia International Trade and Exhibition Centre (MITEC) in Kuala Lumpur this week - the transformation continues  — uniting leaders & innovators from the public and private sectors across the region to shape ASEAN’s AI future. 

On Day 1, YTL AI Labs unveiled ILMU - with an integratable API as Malaysia’s first homegrown LLM. 🤖

My key takeaways:
1️⃣ Untapped data is the region’s opportunity 💎 to unlock insights & breakthroughs.
2️⃣ Collaborative action 🤝 — governments, industries and communities must unite to close the AI gap through education, shared & safe infrastructure, specialized knowledge and localised, regional and world-class models to build an inclusive, resilient digital future.
3️⃣  Adaptive frameworks 👥 — from AI products to talent councils, cross-sector collaboration empowers governments and startups to stay agile & innovate in a rapidly evolving digital landscape, while creating meaningful value for customers, people and society.
4️⃣ The human spark ✨: AI can assist digitally, but real transformation happens when people meet, discuss and co-create solutions.

Thanks to the National AI Office Malaysia (NAIO) Kementerian Digital for enabling ASEAN’s AI journey and curating such a future-focused event.

Here’s to building a responsible, human-centered AI future. 🌏✨

#ASEANAIMalaysia2025 #AIForASEAN #AIForEveryone #InclusiveAI #MinistryofDigital #HumanCenteredAI
